title: Animatable Shapes: animatableData
hints: SwiftUI animates a shape by writing interpolated values into `animatableData`.
Make `animatableData` a computed property that reads and writes `cornerRadius`.
Read the first `.move` point with `path.forEach { if case .move(let p) = $0 { … } }`.
jsBridge: SwiftUI animates a shape by setting `animatableData` to interpolated values every frame and re-calling `path(in:)`. It's like a JS `requestAnimationFrame` tween driving an SVG path, but declarative.

compass.q: In JS you'd tween a number with rAF and redraw. What does `animatableData` let SwiftUI do for you?
What if a shape has two animatable properties? (`AnimatablePair`.)
`animatableData` vs the `@Animatable` macro (iOS 26): what does the macro remove?
Why does a shape snap instead of animating when you forget `animatableData`?
